investment_policy_en: The fund seeks to provide, over the long term, a high level of total return, of which a large component is current income by investing primarily in emerging market bonds and corporate high yield bonds from around the world, denominated in USD and various national currencies (including emerging markets currencies). The fund also aims to manage a carbon footprint that is lower than its corporate indices, and evaluates and applies ESG and norms-based screening to implement a negative screening policy relating to investments in corporate and sovereign issuers.
